paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesikta deRav Kahana 33a and Midrash Tehillim 92:12; see also the entry R' Chanina ben Pazi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The OYW digital text of Midrash Tehillim 92 has Rabbi Chanan bar Pazi in the paragraph beginning להגיד כי ישר ה׳, at the ninth stored paragraph, while Hyman cites 92:12 and uses ben Pazi. The additional Pesikta locator 33a is retained without asserting a verified printed pagination.

The actual OYW Midrash Tehillim 92 paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Chanan bar Pazi. The supplied ben Pazi and 92:12 locator remain distinct from that digital form and stored paragraph position. The uncollated Chanina cross-reference retains R' in the new body. The current note stays verbatim; Pesikta 33a is Hyman’s locator, not a fresh printed-pagination check or an identity binding.
